title: File Processing and Caching
summary: This module manages the lifecycle of files, including normalizing diverse inputs, resolving how they should be handled (uploaded or inlined), caching their metadata, and orchestrating their cleanup. It integrates with external file providers and logs all file-related operations for monitoring.

nodes.label: Receive Raw File Inputs
nodes.title: Raw File Inputs
nodes.description: Accepts diverse file inputs such as paths, URLs, byte data, or file streams from various sources.

nodes.label: Standardize File Inputs
nodes.title: Input Standardization
nodes.description: Converts raw file inputs into a consistent internal FileSource object format for uniform processing across the system.

nodes.label: Configure File Resolution
nodes.title: File Resolution Configuration
nodes.description: Establishes rules for how files should be handled, including preferences for uploading versus inlining, size thresholds, and caching settings, often based on provider capabilities.

nodes.label: Resolve File Handling
nodes.title: File Handling Resolution
nodes.description: Applies configured rules to standardized file inputs to decide whether to upload the file to an external provider or process it inline.

nodes.label: Manage Upload Cache
nodes.title: Upload Cache Management
nodes.description: Stores, retrieves, and manages metadata for files that have been uploaded, tracking their status, expiration, and associated external providers.

nodes.label: Perform Synchronous Cleanup
nodes.title: Synchronous File Cleanup
nodes.description: Executes immediate, blocking cleanup operations to remove expired files from the cache or delete specific files from external providers.

nodes.label: Perform Asynchronous Cleanup
nodes.title: Asynchronous File Cleanup
nodes.description: Handles non-blocking cleanup tasks, allowing for concurrent deletion of multiple expired or uploaded files from the cache and external storage.

nodes.label: Log File Operations
nodes.title: File Operation Logging
nodes.description: Records detailed, structured metrics and logs for all file-related activities, such as uploads, deletions, and processing durations, for monitoring and debugging purposes.

nodes.label: External File Storage
nodes.title: External File Providers
nodes.description: Third-party cloud services (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) that provide storage and management for uploaded files.

nodes.label: Trigger App Exit Cleanup
nodes.title: Application Exit Hook
nodes.description: A system-level mechanism that automatically initiates a final cleanup of uploaded files from the cache when the application process terminates.

groups.label: Data Input & Standardization
groups.title: Data Input & Standardization
groups.description: Handles the reception of raw file inputs and their conversion into a standardized internal format for consistent processing.

groups.label: File Resolution & Configuration
groups.title: File Resolution & Configuration
groups.description: Manages the logic for deciding how files should be handled (e.g., uploaded vs. inlined) and configuring the resolver based on system and provider constraints.

groups.label: Caching & External Storage
groups.title: Caching & External Storage
groups.description: Manages the internal cache for uploaded file metadata and interacts with external cloud services for actual file storage and retrieval.

groups.label: Cleanup & Maintenance
groups.title: Cleanup & Maintenance
groups.description: Orchestrates both synchronous and asynchronous cleanup operations for expired or uploaded files, including integration with application lifecycle events.

groups.label: Observability
groups.title: Operational Monitoring
groups.description: Provides comprehensive logging and structured metrics for all file processing and caching activities, aiding in monitoring and debugging.
